senses.definition: While flying under visual flight rules, finding one's own route without formal reliance on navigation aids, defined fixes, or the like.
Bypassing normal channels, particularly skipping intervening levels in the chain of command.
senses.example: He went VFR direct to the general, and without having gotten his facts straight.

senses.definition: To create or manipulate (something) using visual effects techniques.
senses.example: When we were filming all the scenes in Charlie’s house, I had a huge scab. I think they VFX’d it out and that’s where most of the budget went.
